context: Evaluates whether critique mode explains first, spawns independent varied critics without cross-contamination, stays scoped to architecture, avoids unsupported tradeoff-flagging, and categorizes findings.

checklist.name: explanation_stands_alone_first
checklist.description: The explanation is complete and presented before any critique content, and would satisfy a reader who only wants to understand the system.

checklist.name: independent_varied_critics
checklist.description: Several critics are used with distinct model/effort combinations, and nothing indicates they saw each other's findings before submitting.

checklist.name: no_line_level_nits
checklist.description: No critique finding is a line-level style or naming nitpick; findings stay scoped to architectural concerns.

checklist.name: no_unsupported_tradeoff_flagging
checklist.description: A deliberate tradeoff is not flagged as a problem without a demonstrated concrete cost.

checklist.name: findings_categorized
checklist.description: The final output sorts findings into Act on / Consider / Noted / Dismissed.
